children: Biocon Ltd. shares gained on Tuesday, September 8, after the company said it has secured a 10-year supply contract for Pertuzumab in Brazil.

The company said it has signed the partnership agreement with Bahiafarma and Bionovis for Pertuzumab in Brazil, marking an important milestone in advancing production and commercialization of the HER2-positive breast cancer therapy under the country's productive development partnership (PDP) programme.

Pertuzumab is a monoclonal antibody used in the treatment of HER2-positive breast cancer, Biocon said. At present, the product is not manufactured locally in Brazil and is significant expenditure for the country's united health system.

The consortium of Biocon, Bahiafarma and Bionovis received 100% allocation under Brazil's 10-year PDP programme for Pertuzumab, the company said. The PDP provides the consortium exclusive access to Brazil's public healthcare market, which accounts for around 70% of the country's demand for Pertuzumba. It also supports the long-term adoption of Biocon's product within Brazil's public oncology network, the company said.

Biocon said it will receive milestone payments and a share of revenue generated from the Brazil PDP opportunity over a 10-year period. As part of the PDP framework, the product will undergo phased localization in the mid to long-term.

"This long-term supply contract for Pertuzumab marks a significant milestone in this journey, enabling us to reach more patients living with HER2-positive breast cancer and address an important healthcare need at scale. In partnership with Bahiafarma and Bionovis, we are bringing together science, innovation, manufacturing excellence and local expertise to create a more sustainable pathway for access to this important cancer therapy," Shreyas Tambe, CEO and MD of Biocon, said.

Bahiafarma is a public pharmaceutical laboratory in Bahia, Brazil, focused on research, technology development, innovation and the production and supply of medicines and other health products, particularly for Brazil's SUS. Bionivs is a Brazilian biotechnology firm focused on developing, manufacturing and commercializing complex biological medicine and biosimilars.
Shares of Biocon are trading 1.1% higher on Tuesday after the announcement at ₹395.6. The stock is down 7% in the last one month and has therefore trimmed its year-to-date advance to just 2%.

title: Biocon shares gain after bagging 10-year contract in Brazil for Breast Cancer treatment drug
